<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_birl3_clm.CLMRiskScoringEngine</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CLMRiskScoringEngine</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CLMRiskScoringEngine = Class.create();
CLMRiskScoringEngine.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.TABLES = {
            CUSTOMER:     'x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1',
            OUTSTANDING:  'x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot',
            RISK_MATRIX:  'x_birl3_clm_risk_parameter_matrix',
            REQ_PARAMS:   'x_birl3_clm_request_parameters',
            SITE_REQUEST: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_site_request'
        };

        this.RATING_BANDS = {
            A: ['AAA', 'AA+', 'AA', 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-'],
            B: ['BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-', 'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-'],
            C: ['BB-', 'B+', 'B', 'B-', 'CCC', 'CC', 'C', 'D']
        };

        this.P3_GRID = {
            'A': { 'A': 1.00, 'B': 0.75, 'C': 0.00 },
            'B': { 'A': 0.75, 'B': 0.60, 'C': 0.00 },
            'C': { 'A': 0.00, 'B': 0.00, 'C': 0.00 }
        };
    },

    // =========================================================
    // THRESHOLDS — single source of truth, driven by sys_properties
    // =========================================================
    getThresholds: function() {
        return {
            cement:       parseFloat(gs.getProperty('x_birl3_clm.threshold.cement', '5000000')),
            defaultSeg:   parseFloat(gs.getProperty('x_birl3_clm.threshold.default', '2500000')),
            crossSegment: parseFloat(gs.getProperty('x_birl3_clm.threshold.cross_segment', '15000000'))
        };
    },

    getToolWorkingThreshold: function(segment) {
        var t = this.getThresholds();
        return (segment === 'Cement') ? t.cement : t.defaultSeg;
    },

    // =========================================================
    // PARAMETER RELEVANCE — data-driven via segment_tag field
    // Falls back to name substring match only if segment_tag is
    // not populated on the record (migration safety net).
    // =========================================================
    isParamRelevant: function(param, segment) {
        var tag = (param.segmentTag || '').trim();

        if (tag) {
            return tag === 'All' || tag === segment;
        }

        // Fallback for records not yet migrated to segment_tag
        var name = (param.name || '').toLowerCase();
        var isCem = name.indexOf('cement') !== -1;
        var isRmc = name.indexOf('rmc') !== -1;
        var isBpd = name.indexOf('bpd') !== -1;
        if (!isCem && !isRmc && !isBpd) return true;
        if (isCem && segment === 'Cement') return true;
        if (isRmc && segment === 'RMC') return true;
        if (isBpd && segment === 'BPD') return true;
        return false;
    },

    // =========================================================
    // NUMERIC BUCKET EVALUATION — structured fields first,
    // falls back to legacy label parsing if min/max not set.
    // =========================================================
    evaluateNumberCondition: function(optionsArray, valueToCheck) {
        var val = parseFloat(valueToCheck);
        if (isNaN(val)) return '';

        for (var i = 0; i < optionsArray.length; i++) {
            var opt = optionsArray[i];

            if (opt.operator) {
                switch (opt.operator) {
                    case 'gte':     if (val >= opt.minValue) return opt.sys_id; break;
                    case 'lte':     if (val <= opt.maxValue) return opt.sys_id; break;
                    case 'gt':      if (val >  opt.minValue) return opt.sys_id; break;
                    case 'lt':      if (val <  opt.maxValue) return opt.sys_id; break;
                    case 'between': if (val >= opt.minValue && val <= opt.maxValue) return opt.sys_id; break;
                }
                continue;
            }

            // Legacy fallback: parse the label text
            var match = this._evaluateFromLabel(opt.label, val);
            if (match) return opt.sys_id;
        }
        return '';
    },

    _evaluateFromLabel: function(label, val) {
        var cleanLabel = (label || '').toLowerCase().split('(score')[0].replace(/,/g, '').trim();

        if (cleanLabel.indexOf('-') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('to') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('between') !== -1) {
            var rangeMatch = cleanLabel.match(/([\d.]+)\s*(?:-|to|and)\s*([\d.]+)/);
            if (rangeMatch) {
                var min = parseFloat(rangeMatch[1]);
                var max = parseFloat(rangeMatch[2]);
                return (val >= min && val <= max);
            }
        }

        var singleMatch = cleanLabel.match(/([\d.]+)/);
        if (singleMatch) {
            var numVal = parseFloat(singleMatch[1]);
            if (cleanLabel.indexOf('>=') !== -1) return val >= numVal;
            if (cleanLabel.indexOf('<=') !== -1) return val <= numVal;
            if (cleanLabel.indexOf('=') === -1 && (cleanLabel.indexOf('>') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('greater') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('above') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('more') !== -1)) return val > numVal;
            if (cleanLabel.indexOf('=') === -1 && (cleanLabel.indexOf('<') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('less') !== -1 || cleanLabel.indexOf('below') !== -1)) return val < numVal;
        }
        return false;
    },

    // =========================================================
    // RATINGS
    // =========================================================
    getExternalRating: function(ratingStr, p2Score) {
        ratingStr = (ratingStr || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        if (ratingStr) {
            for (var grade in this.RATING_BANDS) {
                var bands = this.RATING_BANDS[grade];
                for (var k = 0; k < bands.length; k++) {
                    if (ratingStr.indexOf(bands[k]) > -1) return grade;
                }
            }
        }
        var p2Pct = p2Score * 100;
        if (p2Pct >= 61) return 'A';
        if (p2Pct >= 31) return 'B';
        return 'C';
    },

    getInternalRating: function(panValue) {
        var safeL = 0, midM = 0, critN = 0, toxO = 0, recCount = 0;

        var cGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
        cGr.addQuery('pan', panValue);
        cGr.query();

        while (cGr.next()) {
            var custSysId = cGr.getUniqueValue();
            var oGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.OUTSTANDING);
            oGr.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
            oGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            oGr.setLimit(6);
            oGr.query();

            while (oGr.next()) {
                recCount++;
                safeL += (parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_0_30_days'))  || 0)
                       + (parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_31_45_days')) || 0)
                       + (parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_46_60_days')) || 0);
                midM  += parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_61_75_days'))  || 0;
                critN += parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_76_90_days'))  || 0;
                toxO  += (parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_91_120_days'))  || 0)
                       + (parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_121_180_days')) || 0)
                       + (parseFloat(oGr.getValue('bucket_gt120_days'))   || 0);
            }
        }

        return this._rateFromBuckets(safeL, midM, critN, toxO, recCount);
    },

    // Same bucket math, usable directly by the widget's already-fetched
    // in-memory bucket data (avoids re-querying the DB for the live preview).
    getInternalRatingFromBuckets: function(customers) {
        var safeL = 0, midM = 0, critN = 0, toxO = 0, recCount = 0;
        (customers || []).forEach(function(cust) {
            (cust.buckets || []).forEach(function(b) {
                recCount++;
                safeL += (b.b0_3 || 0) + (b.b4_7 || 0) + (b.b8_21 || 0) + (b.b22_30 || 0) + (b.b31_45 || 0) + (b.b46_60 || 0);
                midM  += b.b61_75 || 0;
                critN += b.b76_90 || 0;
                toxO  += b.b_gt90 || 0;
            });
        });
        return this._rateFromBuckets(safeL, midM, critN, toxO, recCount);
    },

    _rateFromBuckets: function(safeL, midM, critN, toxO, recCount) {
        var grand = safeL + midM + critN + toxO;
        if (grand === 0 || recCount === 0) return 'A';

        var pctL  = (safeL / grand) * 100;
        var pctCT = ((critN + toxO) / grand) * 100;

        if (pctL >= 80 && pctCT <= 10) return 'A';
        if (pctL >= 60 && pctCT <= 20) return 'B';
        return 'C';
    },

    getP3: function(extR, intR) {
        return (this.P3_GRID[extR] && this.P3_GRID[extR][intR] !== undefined) ? this.P3_GRID[extR][intR] : 0.00;
    },

    // =========================================================
    // P2 (Composite Index) — DB-backed version, used post-submit
    // once request_parameters records exist.
    // =========================================================
    calculateP2FromRequest: function(reqSysId) {
        var rawScore = 0, totalMax = 0;
        var pGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.REQ_PARAMS);
        pGr.addQuery('request', reqSysId);
        pGr.query();

        while (pGr.next()) {
            var mGr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLES.RISK_MATRIX);
            if (mGr.get(pGr.getValue('risk_parameter'))) {
                var score  = parseFloat(mGr.getValue('score_value'))        || 0;
                var weight = parseFloat(mGr.getValue('weight_percentage')) || 0;
                rawScore += score * weight;
                totalMax += 10 * weight;
            }
        }
        return totalMax > 0 ? parseFloat((rawScore / totalMax).toFixed(4)) : 0;
    },

    // P2 from an in-memory grouped-parameters structure (pre-submit preview,
    // shared by the client preview action so it matches post-submit exactly).
    calculateP2FromParams: function(groupedParameters, segment) {
        var self = this;
        var rawScore = 0, totalMax = 0;

        for (var cat in groupedParameters) {
            var arr = groupedParameters[cat];
            for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                var p = arr[i];
                if (!p.selectedValue || !self.isParamRelevant(p, segment)) continue;
                var opt = null;
                for (var j = 0; j < p.options.length; j++) {
                    if (p.options[j].sys_id === p.selectedValue) { opt = p.options[j]; break; }
                }
                if (opt) {
                    rawScore += (opt.score * opt.weight);
                    totalMax += (10 * opt.weight);
                }
            }
        }
        return totalMax > 0 ? (rawScore / totalMax) : 0;
    },

    // =========================================================
    // Full batch/PAN-level rollup — used both for the submit-time
    // persistence step AND (read-only) for the live Step 4 preview,
    // so the numbers the user sees are guaranteed to match what's saved.
    // =========================================================
    computeReviewSummary: function(opts) {
        // opts: { pan, isListed, panP1IfListed, sites: [{p1, mpq, rate, siteP2}], externalRatingInput }
        var self = this;
        var intR = self.getInternalRating(opts.pan);

        var sumP2Num = 0, sumP2Den = 0, batchSafeLimit = 0, aggregatedP1 = 0, totalP3 = 0;
        var results = [];

        opts.sites.forEach(function(site) {
            var p1 = parseFloat(site.p1) || 0;
            var mpq = parseFloat(site.mpq) || 0;
            var rate = parseFloat(site.rate) || 1;
            var siteP2 = site.siteP2;

            sumP2Num += (siteP2 * mpq * rate);
            sumP2Den += (mpq * rate);

            var extR = self.getExternalRating(opts.externalRatingInput, siteP2);
            var p3 = self.getP3(extR, intR);
            var safe = parseFloat((p1 * siteP2 * p3).toFixed(4));

            batchSafeLimit += safe;
            aggregatedP1 += p1;
            totalP3 += p3;

            results.push({ p1: p1, p2: siteP2, p3: p3, safeLimit: safe, extR: extR, intR: intR });
        });

        var batchP2Avg = sumP2Den > 0 ? parseFloat((sumP2Num / sumP2Den).toFixed(4)) : 0;
        var avgP3 = opts.sites.length > 0 ? parseFloat((totalP3 / opts.sites.length).toFixed(4)) : 0;

        var finalSafe;
        if (opts.isListed) {
            finalSafe = parseFloat((opts.panP1IfListed * batchP2Avg * avgP3).toFixed(4));
        } else {
            finalSafe = parseFloat(batchSafeLimit.toFixed(4));
        }

        return {
            intR: intR,
            batchP2Avg: batchP2Avg,
            avgP3: avgP3,
            finalSafe: finalSafe,
            aggregatedP1: opts.isListed ? opts.panP1IfListed : aggregatedP1,
            perSite: results
        };
    },

    type: 'CLMRiskScoringEngine'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 10:30:16</sys_created_on><sys_id>646fe2bf2bb2cf104572f3745e91bf3c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CLMRiskScoringEngine</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_646fe2bf2bb2cf104572f3745e91bf3c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-26 10:30:16</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
